input.summary: Narrow the Section 6.1 restriction on the Company to Deerskin Products only, cap it at twelve months during the term, and carve out our internal development and acquisitions.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an open-ended restriction on the businesses we operate, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to the named Deerskin Products, deleted the "substantially similar products/companies" language, capped the restriction at twelve (12) months within the term, and carved out our internal development and acquisitions. HDI's exclusive right to use the "Deerskin" brand for the Site is left untouched.

ops.oldText: Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
ops.newText: Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement and in no event for more than twelve (12) months, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products (which restriction shall not apply to the Company's internal development or any acquisition by or of the Company)
